method: Independent read-only source, harness and archived-artifact review; source/Git/build hashing only. Reviewer launched no tests, services, PG, browser or network and read no private state, credentials, process environment or Terminal.

actualEvidence.cleanup: Archived status/cleanup evidence confirms stopped owned PG, absent B/C API/web listeners and runtime/Chrome groups. Reviewer did not independently contact ports or private PG.

sourceReviewFindingsClosed: Only finite stage/outcome/code/cause enums are retained. Error message/stack/raw IPC and credential metadata are excluded; accepted-input marker is set only after successful owner prompt validation and stays false in public diagnostic mode.

Immutable firstFailure is preserved alongside separate bounded cleanupFailures. Relay startup, preflight refusal, owner cancellation, input timeout/refusal and backend failures have separate closed diagnostic codes.
Runtime stage messages cannot satisfy ready. Exact ready contract/origin/admission is required; malformed IPC or missing clean-stop summary fails the run.

Explicit diagnostic mode uses only the public constant, no prompt, exact health-only backend routes and one-minute runtime. Native fetch fallback is replaced with a rejecting transport; runtime also receives per-process deny-network policy allowing only its own PG outbound and API bind/inbound.
Normal real-provider profile retains existing admission; diagnostic mode supplies no A17/user authority or credentials.

preservedFailuresAndUnknowns.A: Preserved failed before runtime IPC; not converted into an AppModule/provider failure.

preservedFailuresAndUnknowns.previousOwnerAttempt: Reason, credential acceptance and external dispatch remain UNKNOWN. The safe retained status does not prove a timeout or absence of prior provider traffic. Previous private state was not read or changed by this review.

limits: Startup and finite current-React DOM/render only, not visual design acceptance or successful onboarding/login/A17/import/branch-binding proof.
Public synthetic partner constant only; no actual owner credential, YCLIENTS compatibility, booking, client/record read, model, notification or C10/full MAYA acceptance.
Runtime OS policy is independently tested for allowed/forbidden loopback and statically denies other network; no external connection was attempted as a test.

Browser proof has builtin Chrome sandbox, empty owned profile, proxy/DNS/background restrictions and exact same-origin static GET interception before navigation. Browser OS-wide packet closure is explicitly NOT_QUALIFIED. Launcher/build preparation is trusted local source, not covered by the runtime OS policy.

Archived safe runtime projections and their sourceUnchanged/cleanup fields are reviewed; original private manifests/keyfiles/PG state are intentionally not re-read. Evidence provenance beyond the archived projections is parent execution evidence.

Harness files are hashed as archived; reviewed archive does not establish a separate immutable pre-execution hash for every scratch harness revision. Final served source and bundle hashes are independently matched.
No new owner prompt or inference of real credential readiness follows from this checkpoint.
